exploit_name: Commission share-burn distribution is JIT-capturable when builderCode is zero
description: When builder code defaults to zero, commission distribution events can be front-run to capture outsized share allocations.
root_cause: When builder code defaults to zero, commission distribution events can be front-run to capture outsized share allocations.

notes: MEV actors extract value by sandwiching commission burns, diluting legitimate PLP rewards.
